entries.name: Planned Spontaneity
entries.description:
You have a measure of flexibility when preparing spells.

Prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 9 ranks, ability to prepare and cast 4th-level spells.

Benefits: Once per day when you prepare spells, you can designate one spell slot from each of up to three different spell levels that are lower than the highest-level spell that you can cast. In each designated slot you can memorize two different spells of the respective level. You can cast either spell as normal, but when you do, the spell consumes both of the spells prepared in that spell slot.

Special: A wizard can select this feat as one of his bonus feats.
entries.prerequisiteText: Knowledge (arcana) 9 ranks, ability to prepare and cast 4th-level spells

prerequisites.unchecked: ability to prepare and cast 4th-level spells

unsupported.reason: Dual-prepared slots up to three levels below maximum and consume-both behavior require preparation/slot/resource state.

situationalNotes.text: Once per day when preparing, designate one slot in each of up to three different spell levels below your highest castable level. Prepare two spells of each slot's level in it; casting either consumes both preparations. Wizards may select this as a bonus feat.

entries.name: Arcane Vendetta
entries.description:
The mistreatment of your people by an arcane society (such as Numeria's Technic League or the White Witches of Irrisen) has made you particularly eager to inf lict harm on those who use arcane magic.

Prerequisites: Spellcraft 1 rank.

Benefits: You deal +2 damage with weapon attacks made against any target you have witnessed casting an arcane spell (not using a spell-like ability) in the last 5 rounds. You must have successfully identified the spell with a Spellcraft check to know without a doubt that the spell is arcane.

situation.local: weapon attacks against a target whose identified arcane spell you witnessed within the last 5 rounds

situationalNotes.text: Weapon attacks deal +2 damage to a target you witnessed casting an arcane spell in the last 5 rounds, provided a successful Spellcraft check identified it as arcane. Spell-like abilities do not qualify.

entries.name: Improved Snap Shot
entries.description:
You can take advantage of your opponent's vulnerabilities from a greater distance, and without exposing yourself.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Weapon Focus, base attack bonus +9.

Benefits: You threaten an additional 5 feet with Snap Shot.

Normal: Making a ranged attack provokes attacks of opportunity.

Combat Trick

At the end of your turn, you can spend 5 stamina points to threaten an additional 15 feet with Snap ShotAPG (instead of an additional 10 feet) until you take an attack of opportunity against an opponent in the expanded threat range or the beginning of your next turn, whichever comes first.
entries.prerequisiteText: Dex 15, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Weapon Focus, base attack bonus +9

unsupported.reason: Additional threatened range +5 feet has no reach statistic. Combat Trick +15 versus referenced +10 disagrees with the base +5; no invented reconciliation, book-only resolution pending. Stamina and opportunity-attack expiry need action state.

situationalNotes.text: Snap Shot threatens an additional 5 feet. Combat Trick text instead says spend 5 stamina at turn end to threaten an additional 15 feet rather than 10 until an opportunity attack against an expanded-range foe or your next turn. The source's base +5 and Combat Trick +10 reference are inconsistent and remain explicit.

entries.name: Kudzu Takeover
entries.description:
Your magical nature infuses your vines, further obscuring grappled foes' vision--even for opponents with enhanced senses.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, base attack bonus +6 or monk level 6th, Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Kudzu Grappler, Kudzu Invasion, vine leshy.

Benefits: Opponents blinded by your Kudzu Grappler feat increase their miss chance against creatures they attack by 20%. If the opponent has means of ignoring blindness, such as blindsight, they instead treat other creatures as if these creatures had normal concealment (20% miss chance).

Normal: All opponents are considered to have total concealment (50% miss chance) against blinded creatures.
entries.prerequisiteText: Dex 13, base attack bonus +6 or monk level 6th, Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Kudzu Grappler, Kudzu Invasion, vine leshy

unsupported.reason: Blind-target miss chance increase +20% or replacement 20% when blindness is ignored require target/sense/concealment state; these alternatives are distinct.

situationalNotes.text: Foes blinded by your Kudzu Grappler add 20 percentage points to their miss chance against creatures. A foe ignoring blindness instead treats other creatures as normally concealed (20% miss chance). Normal blindness gives total concealment (50%).

entries.name: Blighted Critical Mastery
entries.description:
You control the type of spellblight your critical hits give your opponent.

Prerequisites: Blighted Critical, caster level 9th.

Benefits: Whenever you apply a spellblight by way of the Blighted Critical or Greater Blighted critical feat, you can choose the spellblight you apply rather than determining it randomly.

situationalNotes.text: When Blighted Critical or Greater Blighted Critical applies a spellblight, choose it instead of determining it randomly.

entries.name: Forester
entries.description:
You are a master of woodcraft and forest lore and can move through even the densest of trees with ease and grace.

Prerequisites: Favored terrain (forest) class feature.

Benefits: You ignore difficult terrain created by light or heavy undergrowth, and you ignore increased DCs for Acrobatics and Stealth checks in light or heavy undergrowth. In addition, you can use trees to shield yourself from attacks, gaining a +1 cover bonus to your AC whenever you are adjacent to a tree (including while climbing). If you are adjacent to two or more trees simultaneously, you gain a +2 cover bonus to your AC and a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws.

situation.local: when adjacent to two or more trees

unsupported.reason: Cover bonus type is absent from the closed Modifier schema; +1/+2 cover AC remain prose, not untyped bonuses. Undergrowth movement/DC overrides and tree-count state remain manual.

situationalNotes.text: Ignore light/heavy undergrowth difficult terrain and its increased Acrobatics/Stealth DCs. Adjacent to one tree, including while climbing, gain +1 cover AC; adjacent to at least two trees instead gain +2 cover AC and +1 Reflex.

entries.name: Spirit Vision
entries.description:
You retain your senses when seeking a possession target.

Prerequisites: Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability, Wis 15

Benefits: When you sense life forces while seeking a host, you can observe them as you could when you were in your own body. Attempting to possess a body is a standard action.
entries.prerequisiteText: Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability, Wis 15

prerequisites.unchecked: Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability

situationalNotes.text: While magic jar senses life forces for a host, observe them using your ordinary bodily senses. Attempting possession takes a standard action.

entries.name: Defending Eidolon
entries.description:
You have trained your eidolon to protect you.

Prerequisites: Shield ally feature.

Benefits: Whenever you are adjacent to your eidolon, you can choose for the eidolon to take a -1 penalty on melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Armor Class. When your eidolon's base attack bonus reaches +5, and for every +5 thereafter, the penalty increases by -1 and the dodge bonus increases by +1. You must choose to use this feat when your eidolon is making an attack or full-attack action with melee or natural weapons, and its effect lasts until your eidolon's next turn, or until you are no longer adjacent to the eidolon, whichever occurs first.

unsupported.reason: Eidolon BAB controls owner dodge AC 1 + floor(eidolon BAB/5) and eidolon attack/CMB penalties; @bab would incorrectly read owner BAB. Recipient/adjacency/timing state remains unmodeled.

situationalNotes.text: When adjacent to your eidolon as it makes a melee/natural attack or full attack, choose for it to take -1 melee attacks and CMB to give you +1 dodge AC. At eidolon BAB +5 and every further +5, both penalty and bonus increase by 1. Ends at its next turn or when adjacency ends.

entries.name: Crowd of Bullies
entries.description:
Your failed attempt to humiliate a foe reveals its weaknesses to your allies.

Prerequisites: Half-orc.

Benefits: Whenever you fail a combat maneuver check, your allies within 30 feet who also have this feat gain a +2 circumstance bonus on combat maneuver checks of the same type against the same foe for 1 round.

unsupported.reason: The +2 circumstance CMB belongs to nearby qualifying allies, is keyed to the failed maneuver and target, and expires after 1 round; no owner bonus is emitted.

situationalNotes.text: When you fail a combat maneuver, allies within 30 feet who also have Crowd of Bullies gain +2 circumstance on the same maneuver type against that foe for 1 round.

entries.name: Masterful Flourish
entries.description:
Your training with gladiatorial weapons gives you the upper hand when using them in performance combat.

Prerequisites: Weapon training class feature.

Benefits: When wielding a weapon with the performance weapon special quality that belongs to a category of weapons in which you have weapon training, you may add the bonus from your weapon training to any performance combat checks made as a result of using the weapon.

unsupported.reason: Performance combat has no check target; weapon-training bonus copies weapon/group-specific progression rather than an available closed formula.

situationalNotes.text: With a performance weapon in a group you have weapon training in, add your weapon-training bonus to performance combat checks caused by that weapon.

entries.name: Frozen Skin
entries.description:
Rumors abound that winter half-orcs spend so much time in the snow that a thin layer of ice covers their skin.

Prerequisites: Con 15, frostkin half-orc.

Benefits: You gain cold resistance 3. If you already have cold resistance, it is increased by 3 instead.

unsupported.reason: Cold resistance baseline 3 or increase +3 has no resistance statistic; existing resistance must not be counted twice.

situationalNotes.text: Gain cold resistance 3; if you already have cold resistance, increase it by 3 instead.

entries.name: Demon Hunter
entries.description:
You are well-versed in demonic lore.

Prerequisites: Knowledge (planes) 6 ranks.

Benefits: You gain a +2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks to know the powers and abilities of demons. You gain a +2 morale bonus on all attack rolls and a +2 morale bonus on caster level checks to penetrate spell resistance made against creatures with the demon subtype you recognize as demons.

Combat Trick

When you successfully identify a demon using Knowledge (planes), you can spend up to 9 stamina points to increase the morale bonus on attack rolls and caster level checks from Demon Hunter by 1 per 3 stamina points spent.

situation.local: to know the powers and abilities of demons
against creatures with the demon subtype you recognize as demons
to overcome spell resistance of creatures with the demon subtype you recognize as demons

unsupported.reason: Combat Trick adds up to +3 to the morale attack/SR-check bonuses from a chosen stamina spend; resource and identification state must be selected manually.

situationalNotes.text: Gain +2 Knowledge (planes) to identify demon powers/abilities. Against creatures you recognize as demons, gain +2 morale attacks and caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance. Combat Trick: after identifying a demon, spend up to 9 stamina to increase those morale bonuses by 1 per 3 spent.

entries.name: Mud in Your Eye
entries.description:
You are used to fighting in muck and slime, and happily hurl it in your foes' eyes in the heat of battle.

Prerequisites: Throw Anything.

Benefits: As a standard action when in urban or subterranean terrain, you can scoop filth, sewage, mud, or similar grime off a nearby surface and hurl it at a foe as a ranged touch attack with a range increment of 5 feet. If the attack hits, you can immediately attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver against the target as a free action; this dirty trick can be used only to blind the target. As a ranged touch attack, this action provokes attacks of opportunity, even if your dirty trick attempts normally wouldn't provoke such attacks (such as via the Improved Dirty Trick feat).

Special: A character with favored terrain (as the ranger class feature) can use this feat when in any of his favored terrains in addition to urban and subterranean.

unsupported.reason: Grime attack 5-foot range, ranged-touch hit, free dirty-trick blindness and terrain eligibility require attack/action/target state.

situationalNotes.text: In urban or subterranean terrain, standard action: throw nearby grime as a ranged touch attack, range increment 5 feet. On a hit, make a free-action dirty trick only to blind. The ranged touch attack provokes even if your dirty trick normally would not. Favored terrain also qualifies.

entries.name: Dazzling Display (Mythic)
entries.description:
You can quickly deter others with your martial mastery.

Prerequisites: Dazzling Display.

Benefits: While wielding the weapon with which you have Weapon Focus, you can use Dazzling Display as a standard action with a -5 penalty on your Intimidate check, as a move action with a -10 penalty, or as a swift action with a -20 penalty. You can expend one use of mythic power when you make a Dazzling Display to make those affected by the display frightened rather than shaken.

situation.local: using mythic Dazzling Display as a standard action with your Weapon Focus weapon
using mythic Dazzling Display as a move action with your Weapon Focus weapon
using mythic Dazzling Display as a swift action with your Weapon Focus weapon

unsupported.reason: Mythic-power spending and shaken-to-frightened replacement require target/resource state. The three action penalties are mutually exclusive.

situationalNotes.text: With your Weapon Focus weapon, Dazzling Display may be standard (-5 Intimidate), move (-10), or swift (-20). Spend one mythic power to make affected creatures frightened rather than shaken.

entries.name: Heavenly Radiance
entries.description:
Your heavenly light can be used in a variety of ways.

Prerequisites: Aasimar, daylight spell-like ability, sufficiently high level (see below).

Benefits: You gain one additional use per day of daylight. Choose one spell from the table below; by expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level for its listing in the table. The save DC for this spell is Charisma-based.

Spell-Like Ability Minimum Character Level
Flare burst1st
Wake of light3rd
Searing light5th
Wandering star motes7th
Sunbeam (one beam only)9th

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you gain an additional use of daylight and may select another spell from the table.
entries.prerequisiteText: Aasimar, daylight spell-like ability, sufficiently high level (see below)

unsupported.reason: Daylight daily capacity +1 per selection, chosen spell-level eligibility and Charisma-based spell DC require spell-like ability/resource/repeat-selection state.

situationalNotes.text: Gain one additional daylight use per day. Spend a daylight use for one chosen Charisma-based spell-like ability, subject to minimum character level: flare burst 1, wake of light 3, searing light 5, wandering star motes 7, or sunbeam (one beam only) 9. Each repeat selection adds one daylight use and another spell choice.

entries.name: Dirty Trick Master
entries.description:
You are adept at stifling your enemies and can expertly make a bad situation even worse.

Prerequisites: Greater Dirty Trick, Improved Dirty Trick, base attack bonus +11.

Benefits: Whenever you successfully perform a dirty trick combat maneuver against an opponent who is still affected by a condition inflicted by a previous dirty trick (whether your own or another creature's), you can cause the condition to worsen. In addition to increasing the duration of the condition as normal, you cause an opponent who is dazzled to become dazed, entangled to become pinned, shaken to become frightened, and sickened to become nauseated. This worsened condition replaces the previous dirty trick condition, and lasts for the duration of the dirty trick (including any rounds remaining from the previous dirty trick condition) or until the opponent uses a standard action to remove the condition (whichever comes first).
entries.prerequisiteText: Greater Dirty Trick, Improved Dirty Trick, base attack bonus +11

unsupported.reason: Dirty-trick condition substitutions and combined duration require target conditions, prior duration, and maneuver outcomes.

situationalNotes.text: A successful dirty trick against an already dirty-tricked foe may worsen dazzled to dazed, entangled to pinned, shaken to frightened, or sickened to nauseated. Replace the prior condition and keep the combined remaining/extended dirty-trick duration, ending sooner if the foe spends a standard action to remove it.

entries.name: Social Bravery
entries.description:
Even the most stressful social situations don't daunt you, and you weather them as easily as a battle with a dragon.

Prerequisites: Cha 13, bravery class feature.

Benefits: In social situations, your bravado protects you and makes you harder to read. Add your bravery bonus to the DCs of checks to demoralize you, feint against you, change your attitude, or convince you to perform a request (this also applies against Cutting Humiliation and Intoxicating Flattery). Additionally, add a morale bonus equal to your bravery bonus on Bluff and Intimidate checks.

unsupported.reason: Bravery-dependent DC and morale skill bonuses require the actual class-feature bonus (including variants); no independent formula safely reads it.

situationalNotes.text: In social situations add your bravery bonus to DCs to demoralize you, feint against you, change your attitude, or persuade a request, including Cutting Humiliation and Intoxicating Flattery. Gain bravery-sized morale on Bluff and Intimidate checks.

entries.name: Remote Bomb
entries.description:
You can set off your delayed bombs at great distances.

Prerequisites: Delayed bomb discovery.

Benefits: The maximum delay for your delayed bombs increases to a number of minutes equal to your level.

If you have line of effect to your delayed bomb, you may detonate it earlier than its preset time by making a DC 20 Intelligence check; the DC increases by +1 for every 10 feet of distance between you and the bomb.

unsupported.reason: Delayed-bomb duration equal to level, early detonation Intelligence DC 20 + distance/10 and line-of-effect require bomb/timer/distance/check state.

situationalNotes.text: Delayed bombs may wait minutes equal to your level. With line of effect, detonate one early via Intelligence DC 20 +1 per 10 feet of distance.

entries.name: Sleep Venom
entries.description:
You can change the nature of your toxic spittle to put your enemies to sleep.

Prerequisites: Vishkanya.

Benefits: As a swift action, you may alter the effects of your venom so the target falls unconscious. This changes the initial and secondary effect of your venom to the following: initial effect staggered for 1d4 rounds; secondary effect unconsciousness for 1 minute. You must make the decision to alter your venom before you apply it to a weapon.

Normal: Vishkanya venom deals Dexterity damage.

unsupported.reason: Venom effect replacements, initial 1d4 staggered and secondary 1-minute unconscious duration require poison/weapon/target state.

situationalNotes.text: Before applying venom to a weapon, a swift action changes its initial effect to staggered 1d4 rounds and secondary effect to unconscious 1 minute instead of Dexterity damage.

entries.name: Break Guard
entries.description:
You can use one of your two weapons to occupy your opponent's defenses while attacking with the other.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Disarm, Two-Weapon Fighting.

Benefits: While wielding two weapons, whenever you successfully use one weapon to disarm an opponent, you can spend a swift action to attack the opponent you attempted to disarm using your other weapon.

Combat Trick

You can spend 5 stamina points to attack the opponent you disarmed with a free action instead of a swift action.
entries.prerequisiteText: Dex 15, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Disarm, Two-Weapon Fighting

unsupported.reason: Additional attack requires successful disarm, two weapon identities and action/stamina state.

situationalNotes.text: While wielding two weapons, successfully disarming with one allows a swift-action attack with the other against that opponent. Combat Trick: spend 5 stamina to make that attack a free action.

entries.name: Spider Climber
entries.description:
You tread where only arachnids dare.

Prerequisites: Character level 3rd, drow.

Benefits: You can cast spider climb once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level. Furthermore, you gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against the web special attacks of spiders and the effects of web and other similar spells (such as the web cloud spell).

situation.local: against spider web special attacks, web, and similar spells

unsupported.reason: Spider climb daily use and character-level caster level require spell-like ability/resource state.

situationalNotes.text: Cast spider climb once per day as a spell-like ability at caster level equal to character level. Gain +4 saves against spiders' web special attacks, web, and similar spells such as web cloud.

entries.name: Natural Jouster
entries.description:
Nearly all svathurims have the following feat, which is common among tauric creatures.

Prerequisites: Centaur (or any tauric creature at the GM's discretion)

Benefits: You gain proficiency with the lance. You can wield a lance one-handed as if you were mounted, and you deal double damage with a lance while charging.
entries.prerequisiteText: Centaur (or any tauric creature at the GM's discretion)

prerequisites.unchecked: Centaur (or any tauric creature at the GM's discretion)

unsupported.reason: Prose lance proficiency grant has no structured raw array and overlay cannot emit a proficiency grant. One-handed lance permission and charge damage ×2 require weapon/attack state.

situationalNotes.text: Gain lance proficiency. Wield a lance one-handed as though mounted and deal double lance damage on a charge. Tauric eligibility beyond centaurs is at GM discretion in the source.

entries.name: Arc Slinger
entries.description:
You can twirl your sling in a way that maximizes its effectiveness.

Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, proficient with sling or halfling sling staff.

Benefits: When using a sling or sling staff, you reduce your penalty on ranged attack rolls due to range by 2. Point-Blank Shot's damage bonus applies within the first normal range increment of your sling (50 feet) or sling staff (80 feet).

Combat Trick

You can spend 1 stamina point when making a sling or sling staff attack to gain the benefits of Point-Blank Shot within the first two range increments of the sling or staff.
entries.prerequisiteText: Point-Blank Shot, proficient with sling or halfling sling staff

prerequisites.unchecked: proficient with sling or halfling sling staff

unsupported.reason: Range-penalty reduction by 2 must be capped at the remaining range penalty (including Far Shot or other reductions); a flat +2 could grant a bonus when only -1 remains. Point-Blank Shot damage/range extension and 1-stamina two-increment benefit also require parent feat, weapon range, distance, and stamina state.

situationalNotes.text: With a sling or sling staff, reduce range penalties by 2. Point-Blank Shot's damage bonus extends through the first normal range increment: sling 50 feet, sling staff 80 feet. Combat Trick: spend 1 stamina when attacking to gain Point-Blank Shot benefits through the first two range increments.

entries.name: Critical Conduit
entries.description:
You are deadly when delivering your master's magic.

Prerequisites: Deliver touch spells ability, familiar.

Benefits: When delivering a touch spell for your master, the critical threat range of your touch attack is doubled. This feat does not stack with Improved Critical or other effects that increase critical threat range.

unsupported.reason: Doubled touch-spell threat range and nonstacking parent effects require touch-spell attack identity; feat descriptions cannot emit Item Ability doubling mechanics.

situationalNotes.text: When a familiar delivers its master's touch spell, double the touch attack's critical threat range. This does not stack with Improved Critical or other threat-range increases.

entries.name: Rage Casting
entries.description:
Your blood is raw and potent power, and you can burn it to empower your spells.

Prerequisites: Blood casting class feature.

Benefits: When you cast a bloodrager spell, as a swift action you can sacrifice some of your life force to augment the spell's potency. You can opt to take up to 1d6 points of damage per spell level of the spell you are casting, choosing the amount of dice before rolling. You cannot overcome this damage in any way, and it cannot be taken from temporary hit points. For each of these damage dice you roll, the DC of the spell you are casting increases by 1.

unsupported.reason: Chosen sacrifice dice up to spell level, unpreventable self-damage and per-spell DC +1/die require spell/action/HP state; no constant or all-spell DC bonus is emitted.

situationalNotes.text: When casting a bloodrager spell, a swift action sacrifices up to 1d6 damage per spell level, selecting the dice before rolling. This damage cannot be prevented or paid from temporary HP. Increase that spell's DC by 1 per die rolled.

entries.name: Befuddling Strike
entries.description:
You know just where to strike to temporarily send your enemy into a confused stupor.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +8.

Benefits: Befuddling Strike forces a foe damaged by your unarmed attack to attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier), in addition to dealing damage normally. You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll--thus, a failed attack roll ruins the attempt. A defender who fails this saving throw is confused for 1d4 rounds. You can attempt to use Befuddling Strike once per day for every 4 character levels you have, but can use it no more than once per round. Constructs, incorporeal creatures, mindless creatures, plants, undead, and creatures that are immune to critical hits cannot be affected by this ability.

Combat Trick

You can spend 5 stamina points to declare that you are using Befuddling Strike after you've hit with an unarmed strike attack roll.
entries.prerequisiteText: Dex 13, Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +8

unsupported.reason: Fortitude DC 10 + half level + Wisdom, 1d4 confusion, daily floor(level/4) uses, immunity checks, and 5-stamina post-hit declaration require attack/target/resource state.

situationalNotes.text: Declare Befuddling Strike before an unarmed attack; a miss consumes the attempt. A damaged foe makes Fortitude DC 10 + half character level + Wisdom modifier or is confused for 1d4 rounds. Uses: once per 4 character levels per day, at most once per round. Constructs, incorporeal, mindless, plants, undead, and critical-immune creatures are unaffected. Combat Trick: spend 5 stamina to declare after hitting.
